name: my-surge-manager
description: A simple surge manager with Cloudflare Pages and Functions

scripts.build: node scripts/inject-version.mjs && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/surge && cp -R public/. dist/ && cp -R surge/. dist/surge/ && printf "_worker.js\n" > dist/.assetsignore && npx wrangler pages functions build --outdir=dist --output-routes-path=dist/_routes.json --compatibility-date=2026-10-12 && mv dist/index.js dist/_worker.js && node scripts/patch-worker.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently "node scripts/watch-public.mjs" "wrangler pages dev ./dist --compatibility-date=2026-10-12 --proxy=8787"
scripts.test: node tests/e2e.mjs && node tests/db-adapters.test.mjs && node tests/surge-scripts.test.mjs
